headline_marked: Passerby hurt as [[bomb defused near Motijheel Metro station]]
headline: Passerby hurt as bomb defused near Motijheel Metro station
summary: An IED concealed inside an umbrella was discovered and neutralized by the Bomb Disposal Unit, but a pedestrian was injured by shrapnel during the process.
details: An improvised explosive device (IED) hidden inside an umbrella was found near the Motijheel Metro Rail station in Dhaka yesterday evening.
Police cordoned off the area after being alerted and summoned the Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Bomb Disposal Unit to handle the device.
During the disposal operation, a 33-year-old passerby, Miraj Ahmed, was hit by shrapnel from the explosion used to defuse the device.
Miraj, an office assistant at the Ministry of Education, suffered an injury below his left eye and was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital around 8:30 PM.
The victim stated he was walking home past the station when the explosion occurred, leading to a piece of shrapnel striking him.
Husain Muhammad Farabi, assistant commissioner of the Motijheel Zone, confirmed that police have launched an investigation into the incident.
caption:
A bomb hidden in an umbrella was found near a busy metro station in Dhaka. One person was injured during the disposal.

An improvised explosive device (IED) hidden inside an umbrella was found near the Motijheel Metro Rail station in Dhaka yesterday evening.

Police cordoned off the area after being alerted and summoned the Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Bomb Disposal Unit to handle the device.

During the disposal operation, a 33-year-old passerby, Miraj Ahmed, was hit by shrapnel from the explosion used to defuse the device.

Miraj, an office assistant at the Ministry of Education, suffered an injury below his left eye and was rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital around 8:30 PM.

The victim stated he was walking home past the station when the explosion occurred, leading to a piece of shrapnel striking him.

Husain Muhammad Farabi, assistant commissioner of the Motijheel Zone, confirmed that police have launched an investigation into the incident.
